The '''Central Posting Service''' was a branch of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] that was responsible for maintaining records of all the various criminals and criminal organizations that were wanted for questioning at any given point in time. The Central Posting Office ensured that information on every wanted criminal was made available to [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] throughout the galaxy as quickly as possible.
